title: SmimeError is not Serialize/Deserialize but VerificationResult contains it indirectly
description: VerificationResult and SignerResult both derive Serialize/Deserialize (smime-tree/src/error.rs). However, SmimeError does not implement Serialize/Deserialize. If callers store a VerificationResult that contains a SmimeError in any of its fields (e.g. through a future field addition), the serde derives would break. More immediately: callers who want to persist or log VerificationResult cannot round-trip it through JSON if the result internally references any SmimeError. What goes wrong: the promise of Serialize/Deserialize on VerificationResult is inconsistent — it can be serialized today only because no field currently holds SmimeError. Adding #[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)] to SmimeError is the fix; alternatively, document explicitly that SmimeError is intentionally not serializable and that VerificationResult fields are chosen to avoid it. File: smime-tree/src/error.rs.
close_reason: Duplicate of MIME-8zt.70 — SmimeError now has Serialize/Deserialize.
